bugs_found: fx_convert divides converted amount by Decimal(2), silently returning half the correct FX value
transfer does not coerce/validate amount as Decimal, so float/string/NaN inputs can raise unexpected TypeError or bypass intended money validation semantics
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), changing fractional inputs without validation
compound_interest does not reject negative principal, unlike loan_payment, creating inconsistent finance semantics
functions do not validate finite Decimal inputs, so NaN/Infinity can leak into balances or results
